chunks: Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “He will give you two portions of His mercy.”
He عليه السلام said: “Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn.”
“And He will make for you a light by which you will walk.”
He عليه السلام said: “An Imam whom you follow.”

key_terms.إِمَامٌ: a divinely designated leader to be followed
key_terms.تَأْتَمُّونَ: you follow in leadership and guidance
key_terms.رَحْمَتِهِ: His mercy, understood here as a divinely granted favor and guidance
key_terms.كِفْلَيْنِ: two portions or double share of mercy
key_terms.نُورًا: a light, interpreted here as guidance through the Imam

ai.seo_question: How is the Qur’anic phrase about ‘two portions of mercy’ and ‘a light by which you walk’ explained in relation to the Imam?
ai.summary: This report presents a tafsir of part of the verse by identifying “the two portions” with Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn عليهما السلام, and the “light” as an Imam who is followed. Its significance lies in linking divine mercy and guidance to the wilayah and leadership of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Al Qasim Bin Suleyman, from Sama’at Bin Mihran, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [57:28] He will give you all two portions of His Mercy
and Make for you a Light with which you will walk.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The ‘نُور’ (Light) stands for an Imam<sup>asws</sup> you follow’.
en.sarwar: 86. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Sama‘ from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious. “. . Fulfill your covenant with Me ..” (the covenant to acknowledge Wilaya of Ali (a.s.)) and I shall fulfill Mine (admit you in paradise).. .” [2:40]
